children.text: Show that they are all interderivable. (
: to show that three claims are interderivable, it suffices to show that the first proves the second, the second proves the third and the third proves the first; think about why.)

It suffices to show that the first proves the second, the second proves the third and the third proves the first, for we can then show that any of them prove any others, just by chaining the proofs together (numbering lines, where necessary. Armed with this, we start on the first proof:
